ChatGPT for Accounting helps take the busywork out of your month-end close.

Watch how ChatGPT finds completed jobs in your email and drafts QuickBooks invoices for your review, flagging anything unclear along the way.

The Accounting plugin also helps you reconcile transactions, process invoices and receipts, and prepare monthly reports using your existing spreadsheets and connected accounting tools.

Learn more about the plugins: 
https://openai.com/business/solutions/accounting
